parts:
Dear all,

official start of the coding period is today, so welcome to the "real" GSoC!

Here are the "homework done?" questions:

- students: are you in touch with you mentors?
- mentors: are the students in touch with you?
- is the technical side of communications working (IM/skype/whatever
communication)?

Please everyone drop John and me a short line that you are well
connected and working (and if not yet working due to exams etc. please
email, too).

Claudia
